source.excerpt: Shared as a bridge for Hermes installs that are not serving HTTP yet — SSH does the carrying until a real endpoint turns up.

body:
## What it does

Some Hermes setups live on a desktop with nothing exposed over HTTP, which normally leaves them unreachable from elsewhere. This one carries the conversation across a Tailscale SSH session instead, so the agent stays put and you still get to talk to it. A stopgap rather than a permanent design. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @PixelRainbowNFT shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
